dialogue_segments.text: My emerald signet ring fell deep into the frozen blackthorn briars at Ashworth Manor. The thorns have grown over it...

dialogue_segments.label: CLARISSA (Chilling, Sarcastic)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CLARISSA
dialogue_segments.text: ...sharp as steel. The ground is frozen, like pure ice.

dialogue_segments.label: CLARISSA (Demanding, Brutal)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CLARISSA
dialogue_segments.text: You will retrieve it with your bare hands before the magistrate arrives.

dialogue_segments.label: GERALD (Gleeful, Derisive)
dialogue_segments.speaker: GERALD
dialogue_segments.text: A lady's hands will be shredded to ribbons!

dialogue_segments.label: CLARISSA (Cold, Transactional)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CLARISSA
dialogue_segments.text: Do it, and we withdraw the charges.

dialogue_segments.label: CLARISSA (Whispering, Menacing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CLARISSA
dialogue_segments.text: Fail, or refuse, and your husband hangs from the gallows.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Desperate, Protective, Urgent)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: Juliana, no. Do not let them hurt you. I can handle the law.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Fierce, Emotional, Sacrificial)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I am not letting them take you.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Steely, Resolute)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Tell me where the garden is.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Gerald bursts into a loud, mocking laugh beside the stony Constable.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Alexander rests his scarred hand reassuringly on Juliana's shoulder, leaning in toward her.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Juliana clutches the front of her rustic grey dress, her breathing trembling.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Juliana turns her head sharply back toward Clarissa, her expression hardening with fierce resolution.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Juliana locks eyes with Clarissa without flinching as the scene freezes on her brave, sacrificial defiance.
